component.name: Pilot
component.summary: Configure and control Linux with your Chromecast remote and voice dictation

description.p: Pilot is a native GTK4 and Libadwaita settings application and hardware daemon suite designed for the Chromecast with Google TV voice remote over Bluetooth.

ul.li: Media Mode: Dedicated volume, scrubbing, play/pause, fullscreen, and app triggers
Mouse Mode: Smooth mouse movement with exponential acceleration curves using the D-Pad
Whisper Voice Dictation: Push-to-talk voice transcription via faster-whisper
Bedtime Controls: Quick display blanking and suspend timers
Live Testing: Real-time visual feedback for remote button presses and battery status
